tips.text: Run your Radiant relics in a radshare squad so each run rolls several times.
Refine the Rare relics to Radiant and leave the Systems relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Recruit in public Omnia or a vaulted-relic squad; Resurgence relics are not searchable, so recruit chat often fails.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Finish the fissure mission; a failed one voids the relic reward too.
Bank Aya before the window opens; neither it nor your relics expire when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy several copies of the Neuroptics relic; it is the Rare in every one and the bottleneck.
Players say there is no rush: Resurgence repeats, and the route people regret is solo-running unrefined Rare relics.
